Karnataka to conduct SIR exercise for electoral roll

Karnataka is set to implement the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise for its electoral roll starting June 30. This process will involve enumerating residents to update the voter list. Documents related to this exercise will be considered valid for the electoral roll update.
